reviewMethod: Two independent blind read-only reviewers, followed by main source/answer adjudication before final aggregation. Arm mapping opened only after both reviews returned. Grades are not keyword scores.
sourceChecks: server/api/v1/acl_config.go:45-79 and authz.go:99-116 distinguish public registration from the private-instance bootstrap exception.
core/access/memo_resolve.go:31-90 resolves creator/placement/membership before policy validation; equal final NotFound does not explain that order.
server/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:26-38 independently reloads the creator; memo_share_service.go:203-208 maps missing creator to NotFound and wraps other conversion errors.

independentReviews.initial: All six domains full, all four core relations correct, whole full for all three; no severe claims; usesComputedResults=true.
independentReviews.adjudication: Rejected unsupported full ratings where actual answer lacks bootstrap registration or context-before-policy order. A scenario value alone does not establish execution-result adoption.

RE text explicitly names the second creator lookup and includes NotFound/wrapped-conversion rows; its response grade is full. N separately describes the conversion query and missing creator mapping, so its core conversion relation is correct, though the response domain still omits the other-error mapping. The reviewer's non-schema core grade partial is replaced by the registered correct/not-covered distinction.
